frames.subject: swirl marble ribbon colour swatch
frames.prompt: Flat square texture swatch that fills the entire frame edge to edge: the twisted coloured glass ribbons from inside a classic swirl marble, unrolled flat and seen straight on. Several long flowing vertical ribbons of saturated colour side by side: tangerine orange, sunflower yellow, cobalt blue and a thin white ribbon, each ribbon with soft internal striations and gently twisting edges, narrow gaps of deep dark glass between them. Even flat lighting, no shadows, no specular glare, no marble, no sphere, no background, no border. Orthographic texture map for a 3D material, photoreal macro detail. No text, no logos, no watermark.
frames.transformations: none; stored exactly as delivered by the provider CDN

runtimeDerivative.use: embedded in parble-render (include_bytes) as the swirl marble's ribbon vanes (High-tier vane mesh and Low/Medium vane_glass.wesl fallback)
